description: This file defines the InstallerKernel class which extends DrupalKernel to customize kernel behaviors during Drupal installation, including container initialization, configuration storage management, profile handling, and theme extension management.

classes.name: InstallerKernel
classes.description: A specialized kernel class for handling Drupal installation processes with forced container rebuilds and profile/theme management.

methods.name: initializeContainer
methods.description: Forces container rebuild and disables container dumping during installation.

methods.name: resetConfigStorage
methods.description: Resets the configuration storage to NULL, used during database runTasks.

methods.name: getConfigStorage
methods.description: Returns the active configuration storage used during early install.

methods.name: getInstallProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the current install profile, considering global install state.

methods.name: installationAttempted
methods.description: Checks if a Drupal installation is currently being attempted based on global install state.

methods.name: attachSynthetic
methods.description: Resets the container to prevent memory leaks during multiple module installations.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves extensions, ensuring system module and profile themes are available during installation.

methods.name: getBaseThemes
methods.description: Determines the base themes for a given theme by parsing theme info files.

methods.name: installGetProfile
methods.description: Selects the profile to be installed based on install state and available profiles.
